name: Hades
description: Hades is a self-hosted media management server and companion backend for Icarus. It centralizes supported media-service connections such as Sonarr, Radarr, and Seerr and provides a unified library for Icarus clients, including Apple TV. This is a community-maintained Unraid template; Hades itself is developed by the Pantheon/Icarus developers.

paths.name: Hades Config
paths.description: Persistent Hades configuration, databases, integration credentials, and library data.

ports.name: Web/API Port
ports.description: Port used by the Hades web interface, API, and Icarus clients.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used by Hades. Change this to your local TZ database timezone if necessary.

variables.name: Catalog Work Profile
variables.description: Controls the Hades catalog worker profile. Balanced is the recommended general-purpose setting.

variables.name: Local Recovery
variables.description: Controls the Hades local recovery feature. Disabled by default.
